subject: Finalizing panel slots + tech contingency for Cortex webinar
body:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, anna@cortexanalytics.com
Cc: production@webinarstream.io
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing panel slots + tech contingency for Cortex webinar

Team / Anna —

Thanks for making time this week. Quick note to lock in the panel timing and surface our contingency plan for any AV trouble the day of. The goal is a tight 45-minute customer panel with 3 speakers + a short demo clip. Two asks:

1) Please review the attached panel_slot_matrix.xlsx and confirm the final speaker order and arrival/check-in windows. I tried to balance customer availability and internal SMEs (Marissa will introduce the product thread; Karthik will run the demo hand-off).

2) Approve the tech fallback plan in run_of_show_v2.pdf. Key highlight: we will stage a local recording node and an alternative dial-in bridge (production@webinarstream.io) if Zoom audio drops. Lauren — can you confirm the AV tech lead and the standby timeline?

If Anna can confirm sponsor logo assets by EOD tomorrow we can finalize the slide deck. I attached a sponsor_logo_pack.zip stub for reference.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Anna: Confirm final speaker display names + logo (by 8/26 EOD)
- Marissa: Finalize two intro slides + one handoff slide to demo (by 8/26 noon)
- Karthik: Walkthrough of demo handoff (15 minutes) on 8/27 morning
- Lauren: Confirm AV lead and backup dial-in bridge (by 8/26 afternoon)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

---

From: Anna Liu <anna@cortexanalytics.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing panel slots + tech contingency for Cortex webinar

Hi Vanessa + team,

Thanks — this looks good. Quick answers:
- Speaker names: I will be joined by Priya Desai (SVP Product) and Miguel Santos (Head of Data Ops). Please use the display names Priya Desai and Miguel Santos.
- Logo: I uploaded the logo pack to the shared Drive link you sent and also attached a .zip here.

We're fine with the proposed order — prefer to have our customer story first, followed by a short demo. I can be on a 30-minute call for a quick pre-check on 8/27 at 9:30 PT.

Anna
Head of Partnerships
Cortex Analytics

Attachment: sponsor_logo_pack.zip (image files inside)

---

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, anna@cortexanalytics.com
Cc: production@webinarstream.io
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing panel slots + tech contingency for Cortex webinar

All —

Confirmed: AV lead will be Jordan Miles (production@webinarstream.io contact), and hes scheduled for a full tech check on 8/27 at 10:00 PT. Jordan will own the dial-in bridge and the recording node. If the Zoom stream drops, we'll move attendees to the backup bridge and continue the talk; we'll place a static slide in Zoom with the bridge URL.

I updated the run_of_show_v2.pdf (attached) with exact cue times and the backup switch at 00:22:00 in the timeline. Also added a short note about what to do if a speaker has upload issues (we’ll load their slide deck on the recording node and push from there).

Lauren Bishop
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: run_of_show_v2.pdf

---

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, anna@cortexanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing panel slots + tech contingency for Cortex webinar

Quick update from content: I trimmed the intro slide to one (company + one-sentence customer outcome) and added the handoff slide to demo with Karthik's checklist included. Karthik — can you verify the demo checklist steps below match what you'll need on 8/27?

- Pre-load model checkpoint to the recording node (model: redwood-open-13B, quantized)
- Confirm API creds are scoped to the demo account
- Start local recorder 2 minutes before go time
- Fallback: play recorded demo clip if live demo fails

If that matches, I'll add the checklist to the speaker notes.

Marissa Cole
Content Lead, Events
Redwood Inference

---

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, anna@cortexanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing panel slots + tech contingency for Cortex webinar

All good — checklist looks right. Two notes:
1) I will join the 8/27 tech check at 10:00 PT (Jordan's slot) and we can run the demo handoff at that time.
2) For the model preload: I will stage the quantized checkpoint on the recording node and run a 30s warmup to populate KV cache so first tokens are not slow. If the demo needs lower latency we will short-circuit to a smaller model variant; Ill bring the fallback decision to the call.

See you on Friday.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
